notes.title: Dont press the credit button!
notes.notes: The credit button will reset your achievements. So unless you want to reset them, dont press it until the next build is out, which should be in the next couple weeks.

notes.title: Update is now live
notes.notes: I was able to solve the issue and the update is now live. We added 10 more achievements and fixed the issue with the stamina. The player will now start with full stamina on each level. Any issues fell free to contact us. Thanks and hope to have some more updates for you sometime soon.

notes.title: Working on update
notes.notes: We had some technical issue and are back to work. We are currently working on the update and in the process of adding more achievements and fixing some other issues. Once we get all the issue resolved we will post that build live and explain what was done.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes: We will be working on an update this week, so let us know if you run into any bugs! We will also be adding more achievements throughout the updates that we will have in the future. I know some people enjoy steam trading cards and we are in the process of making those for our game as well! So I hope enjoy our game and feel free to contact us!!
